description: This file defines data structures and a class for managing a hierarchical test tree, including types for test items, groups, and methods for filtering, sorting, and collecting test data within a testing framework.

classes.name: TestTree
classes.description: Class for constructing and manipulating a hierarchical test tree, including filtering, sorting, and flattening test items.

methods.name: sortAndPropagateStatus
methods.description: Sorts children of a tree item and updates its status based on children's statuses.

methods.name: collectTestIds
methods.description: Collects all test IDs and file locations from a tree item.
